secrets.name: NEON_DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Postgres connection string for the existing Neon database (Neon dashboard). Required at boot.

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Long random string used to sign JWTs. Required at boot (a dev placeholder is provided until set).

secrets.name: PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase PUBLIC project URL (creator video storage).

secrets.name: OWNER_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase OWNER project URL (owner/admin video storage).

secrets.name: MEDIA_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase MEDIA project URL (avatars, banners, QRIS images).

secrets.name: TEMANQRIS_API_KEY
secrets.description: TemanQRIS API key for payment links (top-up only).
